name_zh: 流式細胞與免疫學資料
intro_zh: FCS、CyTOF、gating 和免疫學研究。FlowRepository 著重原始流式實驗，ImmPort／ImmuneSpace 涵蓋多種免疫檢驗，HDCytoData 提供演算法基準。
intro_en: FCS, CyTOF, gating and immune studies: raw flow experiments, multi-assay immune portals and curated cytometry benchmarks.

intro_zh: 紅血球／白血球影像、血液抹片與細胞形態標註，用於分割、定位及分類模型。ALL-IDB 有資料申請程序。
intro_en: Red- and white-cell images, smears and ground-truth labels for counting, detection and classification. ALL-IDB has access requirements.

name_zh: 顯微影像、組織病理與數位病理
intro_zh: 通用螢光顯微、組織 IHC／IF、高內涵細胞影像及放射影像。Human Protein Atlas 跨蛋白體，Cell Painting 跨藥物表型。
intro_en: Microscopy, tissue IHC/IF, high-content cell imaging and cancer radiology, including cross-disciplinary protein and compound phenotypes.

intro_zh: Microarray、RNA-seq、ATAC/ChIP、正常組織表現和 FASTQ 原始讀段；GEO、GTEx、ENCODE、ArrayExpress、SRA 可依研究設計選擇。
intro_en: Expression arrays, RNA-seq, epigenomics, tissue eQTLs and raw reads: GEO, GTEx, ENCODE, ArrayExpress and SRA.

intro_zh: CELLxGENE、Human Cell Atlas、10x 公開示範資料及 HuBMAP，涵蓋單細胞表現、空間分布與器官圖譜。
intro_en: CELLxGENE, Human Cell Atlas, 10x examples and HuBMAP for single-cell matrices, spatial omics and organ atlases.

name_zh: 癌症基因體與細胞株篩選
intro_zh: 區分 GDC 的癌症原始／臨床檔案、cBioPortal 的隊列整合查詢，以及 DepMap 的細胞株 CRISPR 依賴性與藥物反應。
intro_en: GDC cancer cohorts, cBioPortal study exploration and DepMap cancer cell-line dependencies and phenotypes.

name_zh: 蛋白質體、結構與藥物活性
intro_zh: PRIDE 質譜、UniProt 註解、PDB 實驗結構、AlphaFold 預測結構及 ChEMBL 藥物／靶點活性，資料證據類型各異。
intro_en: MS archives, protein annotations, experimental versus predicted structures, and curated compound–target bioactivity.

name_zh: 代謝體、質譜與臨床化學
intro_zh: LC-MS／GC-MS／NMR 原始實驗、參考光譜與代謝物註解；MetabolomicsHub 整合搜尋，MassIVE 與 GNPS 可能索引相同研究。
intro_en: LC-MS, GC-MS, NMR studies, metabolite references and spectral networking; integrated portals may index the same deposited experiments.

intro_zh: SILVA 為 16S／18S rRNA 分類參考，MGnify 提供微生物群定序分析，EnteroBase 為菌株基因體與 MLST；三者用途不同。
intro_en: SILVA rRNA reference taxonomy, MGnify microbiome analyses, and EnteroBase bacterial genomes and sequence typing.

intro_zh: CARD／MEGARes／CLEVER 屬抗藥基因及變異參考；NCBI AST Browser 供查詢提交的菌株 MIC／抑菌圈。基因推測與實測表型須分開解釋。
intro_en: CARD, MEGARes and CLEVER gene/variant references alongside NCBI isolate-level phenotypic AST; genotype and phenotype are distinct evidence.

name_zh: 感染症與抗藥性監測統計
intro_zh: WHO GLASS 及 ECDC 提供監測統計、國家或年度比較。匯總指標會受回報涵蓋、抽樣與分母定義影響。
intro_en: WHO GLASS and ECDC surveillance summaries, with reporting-coverage, sampling and denominator caveats.

name_zh: 生理訊號與神經電生理
intro_zh: PhysioNet 包含 ECG／臨床生理訊號；NEMAR、OpenNeuro 著重 EEG／MEG 等資料，DANDI 包含 NWB 神經電生理與鈣影像。
intro_en: PhysioNet clinical signals, OpenNeuro/NEMAR EEG and MEG, plus DANDI NWB neurophysiology and calcium-imaging series.
